description: Beautifully remodeled home in the heart of Tarzana featuring 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms with a bright open floor plan perfect for comfortable living and entertaining. The spacious living room offers a cozy fireplace and large sliding glass doors overlooking the sparkling pool, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living. The remodeled kitchen is equipped with quartz countertops, abundant cabinetry, and a skylight that fills the space with natural light. The front yard is oversized and inviting, complete with a charming porch and ample space for gatherings and entertainment. The backyard is designed for relaxation with a pool, safety gate enclosure, built-in BBQ area, and a covered patio providing plenty of shade. Laundry area is conveniently located under the covered porch. Additional upgrades include recessed lighting throughout, dual-pane windows, new flooring, and fresh interior paint.
